idea: How to prevent bad smells from drains
title: Maintaining the P-Trap Water Seal to Prevent Drain Odors
description: Bad odors coming from sink or floor drains are often caused by a dried-out water seal inside the P-trap. The P-trap's curved dip holds a small pocket of standing water, acting as a physical barrier that prevents foul sewer gas from entering your room. When a sink or floor drain goes unused for extended periods, this water barrier evaporates, opening a direct path for odors. If you notice a sewage smell near an infrequently used fixture, pour clean water down the drain to re-establish the liquid barrier. Regular flushing keeps traps sealed effectively.

on_image_text.hook: Why Does Your Drain Smell Like Sewer Gas?
on_image_text.explanation: P-traps hold standing water that acts as a physical barrier against foul drain odors.
on_image_text.takeaway: Pour water into unused drains weekly to maintain the protective water seal.
